difficultyLevels.about: Every animal spawns with a difficulty level that reflects its potential size/trophy and how wary it is. Each species has its own cap: small game, birds, roe deer and whitetail top out at level 3; moose and mule deer at 5; red deer, lion and other big trophy species at 9. Great Ones are always level 10 'Fabled' regardless of the species' cap. Difficulty level does not by itself set the trophy score; a higher level means a higher possible weight/score range (diamond potential is mostly on the top one or two levels).

sources.title: theHunter: Call of the Wild Diamond Chart & Animal Level - gameslikefinder

trophyRatings.about: After a harvest the trophy is scored by its Trophy Rating (TR): antlers/horns/tusks for most deer and bovids (measured by the TruRACS system), or skull/weight for species without a distinct trophy. The TR is compared with that species' fixed thresholds to award Bronze, Silver, Gold or Diamond. Diamond is roughly the top 10% of the possible range. Failing the harvest check drops the medal one tier. Great Ones score far above the diamond threshold and their atypical racks are flagged 'atypical' on the TruScore screen.
trophyRatings.diamondRule: Trophy rating of at least ~90% of the species' maximum (community rule of thumb).

sources.title: theHunter: Call of the Wild Diamond Chart & Animal Level - gameslikefinder
Patch 9.3 Notes

harvestCheck.about: Every kill gets a harvest check with four criteria: (1) ammo rated for the animal's class, (2) no more than two shots/hits, (3) trophy organ intact (e.g. don't shoot the antlers/skull you are scoring), (4) at least one vital-organ hit. Failing any criterion lowers the medal by one tier (so a diamond-sized animal becomes gold at best) and reduces cash, XP and weapon score. Some missions require a passed harvest check.

sources.title: theHunter: Call of the Wild Diamond Chart & Animal Level - gameslikefinder

integrity.about: Integrity was the original (2017-era) measure of how cleanly the animal was killed with appropriate ammo; it fed an 'integrity bonus' on the payout. Its job is now done by the harvest check: using ammo outside the animal's class range fails the check. The ammo, not the weapon, determines the class check, so one gun can cover several classes by switching loads.

sources.title: Nexus Mods: Modify Ammo guide (ammo determines integrity class)

animalClasses.about: Animals are grouped into classes 1-9 by size/toughness. Each ammo type is rated for a class range (e.g. .243 = 2-6). Class assignments were standardised in Update 1.81 (12 March 2024), so pre-2024 charts can be off by one for some species.

sources.title: Pump, Flip and Fire Pack - official page (class names)
Rapid Hunt Rifle Pack - official page (class names)
Update 1.81 - MP1st (class standardisation, March 2024)

needZones.about: Each herd has need zones - Feed, Drink and Rest - that it visits in fixed time windows during the 24-hour day. Zones always exist but only appear on your map (with the species icon and times) once you discover them by spotting animals using them or finding the zone. Animals typically stay within ~250 m of their zone and head toward it before the window opens, so waiting between two zones works well. Harvesting too many animals in one place (players say more than three) can erase that herd's zones, and killing the only animal tied to a newly found zone can disconnect it from your map.

furRarities.about: Each species has fur variants with spawn chances grouped into rarity tiers. Mission furs are tied to specific named mission animals; Great One (Fabled) furs only appear on Great Ones.

sources.title: theHunter: Call of the Wild Rare Fur Types List - gameslikefinder (updated 2026-06-24)

hunterScoreAndRewards.about: Each harvest pays cash and XP scaled by the animal, its trophy medal and the harvest check. Shots also build weapon-category score (rifle, handgun, shotgun, archery) that unlocks weapons, ammo and scopes in the store, and XP gives skill/perk points. Since the Dec 2024 Winter Update, daily and weekly Hunter Challenges also award in-game currency. Wrong-class ammo or a failed harvest check lowers the medal and the payout.

sources.title: Winter Update press release, 3 Dec 2024 (Hunter Challenges)

trophyLodges.about: Trophy lodges are walk-in spaces where harvested animals can be taxidermied as wall plaques or full-body mounts (several poses) and guns shown on racks; lodges can be duplicated, renamed (since 1.73) and visited by friends.

lodges.name: Trophy Cabin
lodges.about: Free lodge added in Update 1.73 'Showcase'; pool table and hot tub. Originally for Layton Lake and Hirschfelden trophies.
